verdict.rationale: Secureframe supports recurring, scheduled workflows for specific built-in processes (user access reviews, vendor risk reviews, continuous daily monitoring/alerts) with reminders and notifications, and exposes an API/MCP server for accessing and managing compliance objects programmatically. However there is no evidence of a general-purpose job/workflow scheduler exposed via the API or MCP server that an AI-native user could use to schedule arbitrary recurring automation — the recurring capability is tied to fixed platform features, not a programmable scheduling primitive. Missing for 10: API/MCP-exposed scheduling endpoint or cron-like job creation, evidence of AI agents triggering/scheduling custom recurring workflows beyond built-in reviews/monitoring.
